audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitleAdmin: Every action taken in your organization: who took it, whether by hand or through the AI assistant, and what it changed.
audit.subtitleMember: Your own actions, and actions on the records you're allowed to view.
audit.noChanges: No field changes were recorded for this entry.

errors.load: The audit log could not be loaded.
errors.revert: This action could not be undone.

reasons.not_an_action: This entry is a record of an event, not an action that can be undone.
reasons.is_a_revert: This entry is itself an undo.
reasons.already_reverted: This action has already been undone.
reasons.not_reversible: This kind of action can't be undone here. Use the proper business reversal instead, such as a return or a correcting entry.
reasons.no_permission: You don't have permission to perform this action, so you can't undo it.
reasons.changed_since: This record has been changed since. Undo the later changes first.
reasons.failed: The undo could not be completed.

revert.title: Undo this action?
revert.note: The log is never edited. The undo is recorded as a new entry under your name.

effects.create: The record that was created will be deleted.
effects.update: The record will be set back to the values it had before this change.
effects.delete: The record will be created again from the copy kept in the log. It gets a new number, and anything that referred to the old one is not re-linked.
effects.post_entry: A posted journal entry can't be unposted. A reversing entry, with every debit and credit swapped, will be posted today instead.
effects.other: The record will be put back to the state it was in before this action.

items.q: Can the AI change my data on its own?
items.a: No. It can read what you are allowed to read and prepare changes you are allowed to make, but every change waits for a person to approve it. Approved changes run under that person's name and are written to the audit log.

items.q: Does the AI make up numbers?
items.a: Figures and charts are computed by the system from your records, not written by the AI, and each answer shows the table or chart it is based on. You should still treat it as an assistant: check the table next to an answer before acting on it.

items.q: Do I have to use every module?
items.a: No. Each area is a plugin. Start with finance and add inventory, sales or payroll when you need them. Removing a plugin hides its screens without deleting any data.

items.q: Is it ready for Turkish e-Fatura and e-Defter?
items.a: Not yet. The accounting follows the Tekdüzen Hesap Planı and payroll follows Turkish rules, but direct e-document filing with GİB is still being built. It is the first item on the roadmap.

Usually, yes. Creating, editing and deleting records can be undone from the audit log, as can steps like sending an invoice or approving a request. Actions that move stock or money, such as receiving goods or a POS sale, are corrected with a return or a correcting entry instead.
You decide, action by action. Someone without permission to view invoices cannot see them in the screens, in the dashboard, in the audit log or through the assistant.
